hints.title: Augment State with Remaining Eliminations
hints.text: A visited state is defined by row r, column c, and remaining obstacle eliminations k.

hints.title: Manhattan Shortcut Optimization
hints.text: If k >= (m - 1) + (n - 1), you can walk straight to the bottom right without impediment in Manhattan distance steps.

hints.title: Pruning Visited States
hints.text: Keep track of the maximum remaining eliminations seen for each cell (r, c). Only enqueue if strictly greater.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard 2D BFS without tracking obstacle elimination count fails to find detour paths.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking remaining eliminations per grid position guarantees finding the shortest path.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies 3D state (r, c, k) and applies BFS for shortest unweighted path.
complexity.notes: Early exit when K >= M + N - 2 provides huge practical speedup.
